t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2006, a building that no longer stands. It was designed by Rem Koolhaas, the Dutch architect, theorist and urbanist. Koolhaas is often cited as a representative of deconstructivism, and he teaches architecture and urban design at Harvard's Graduate School of Design. He is also the author of Delirious New York, his retroactive manifesto for Manhattan. I can't tell you more about the structure itself from what I have, but it's worth knowing who stood behind the design.
